questions.question: AI researcher Yann LeCun is a professor at which university's Courant Institute?
questions.note: He works on AI, machine learning, computer vision and robotics.

questions.question: Astro Boy, the robot-boy hero, was created by which manga artist?
questions.note: In Japan the series is called Mighty Atom.

questions.question: Who stars in the 1999 film "Bicentennial Man"?
questions.note: The film is based on a novelette by Isaac Asimov.

questions.question: In the 1982 film "Tron", programmer Kevin Flynn is transported into...
questions.note: Jeff Bridges plays Kevin Flynn.

questions.question: Bender, the robot in "Futurama", is voiced by...
questions.note: Bender was conceived by Matt Groening and David X. Cohen.

questions.question: In "Star Wars", R2-D2 is what type of droid?
questions.note: R2-D2 is a close friend of C-3PO.

questions.question: In "Knight Rider", the AI car KITT was a modified...
questions.note: KITT is an artificially intelligent computer module in a robotic car.
